About

Hi! I'm Otis, I'm a 4th-year blended Master's student in Statistics at Cal Poly SLO, set to graduate in December 2027. I also carry a “Cross Disciplinary Minor in Data Science”, which is close to a double major in Data Science. Undergraduate Researcher, Simulation (lomad) · Cal Poly SLO
